name: treg
title: treg
description: Search 4,000+ catalogued provider endpoints (SEO, SERP, backlinks, social, enrichment, ads, scraping, media generation) and call them through treg.to — one token, credentials stay on treg's servers, every answer reports what it cost.
short_description: 4,000+ priced API tools through one treg.to token
author: Iteractive Development

preferences.name: org
preferences.title: Team slug
preferences.description: Optional X-Treg-Org, needed only for a personal (identity) token that is not pinned to a team.

preferences.name: maxCostUsd
preferences.title: Default per-call ceiling (USD)
preferences.description: Sent as X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost when a call does not set its own. Empty means treg's routed-call default ($1) and no ceiling on direct calls.

commands.name: credentials
commands.title: treg Token
commands.description: Store and validate the treg API token this plugin's commands and routes use. Managed through Enconvo's standard credential management; validated live against treg.to when saved.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: treg Token
preferences.description: Org-scoped agent token (mint with `treg org agent-new <name>`, or a dashboard API key)

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search treg Catalog
commands.description: Find catalogued endpoints by the job you need done, with prices and success rates.

commands.name: call
commands.title: Call treg Tool
commands.description: Make the real upstream request to a catalogued endpoint id through treg.to and see what it cost.

commands.name: balance
commands.title: treg Balance
commands.description: Show the treg team's billing and balance.

positive.prompt: Search the treg catalog for backlinks for a domain
positive.expected_behavior: Route treg/catalog/search answers ok:true with priced, rated results

positive.prompt: Get the details and price of treg.web.backlinks.list
positive.expected_behavior: Route treg/catalog/endpoint returns parameters, price and a ready call line
Without a stored token the route answers 401 not authenticated and never echoes a credential
